verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants read, summarize, draft and send emails, schedule meetings, and run follow-up workflows across connected Gmail/Outlook accounts. That gives programmatic access to a core subset of UI actions. However, probes found no public REST API or OpenAPI spec, and the docs never claim parity with the UI. Many UI features show no programmatic surface: Auto Labels, split inbox, Snippets, team comments, Auto Archive and agent building. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API, evidence of UI-feature parity (labels, split inbox, snippets, team features, settings), an API reference/spec, and independent corroboration.
